title: Fix busy loop in single threaded agent runtime
body:
### Discussed in https://github.com/microsoft/autogen/discussions/4772
Originally posted by **un-hongly** December 20, 2024 ``` team.run_stream(task=input.message) async for message in stream: pass ``` `async for message in stream` cause high cpu usages.
We need to replace this busy loop with proper eventing based on when messages are available to be consumed. https://github.com/microsoft/autogen/blob/a4c1314432299605e1ef0777f4c5dc3ba9d6482b/python/packages/autogen-core/src/autogen_core/_single_threaded_agent_runtime.py#L446

linked_prs.title: fix!: Fix SingleThreadedAgentRuntime busy loop
linked_prs.body:
Closes #4773

Breaking change:

- `unprocessed_messages -> List` changed to `unprocessed_messages_count -> int`

ai_judgment.response: Yes. The issue describes a workflow anomaly in the agent system, specifically a busy loop causing high CPU usage in a single-threaded agent runtime. This aligns with the "Workflow issues" category, as it involves errors in the scheduling or execution of the agent's workflow.
